_meta.purpose: Machine-parseable event design sheet - the JSON twin of 26_TEMPLATE_event_design. A filled instance of this schema is the complete input contract for an agentic event build (roadmap Level 4). Prose sheet stays for humans; the pipeline consumes THIS.
_meta.fill_semantics: null or absent = designer's call within doctrine (the AI decides and lists the decision in the delivery summary). The literal string 'NONE' = explicitly excluded. The literal string 'dauntless' = reserved placeholder, carry unfilled and list in the decision summary. Every dauntless field ships as a safe default, flagged.
_meta.validation: Instances lint against 13_LINT-adjacent checks: required fields present, enums legal, band math coherent, component/recipe factors coprime.

identity.name: string, event title (dedup-checked against live quests)
identity.event_type: enum: daily_repeat | weekend | battlepyramid | story_arc | hidden_discovery | war_support

structure.pattern: enum: wings_cyoa | linear_gauntlet | pyramid | hub_and_spokes | hunt_gather_mirror
structure.entrances: int (wings_cyoa: 2-4; each entrance lists which endings it reaches)

endings.knowledge_gate: null | {question_source: 'node id where the answer is overheard', hi_rate: 'pct or dauntless', lo_rate: 'pct or dauntless'}

structure.intel_nodes: list of {id, exclusive: bool} - exclusive intel = one pick per run
structure.scenes: map node-group -> asset srcId (art_pack below must cover every value)

roster.name: string
roster.tier: enum: add | entry | mid | boss | finale
roster.kit: list of S-pool ids (32_REGISTRY) - new records ONLY for shapes the pool lacks
roster.shared_item: srcId of the roster item (Regalia pattern) or NONE

enemies.scaling: opponent_scaled_to_user per battle node; finale fights may pin fixed level
enemies.stat_block: always the full 21-guide payload (rank JONIN default, regeneration 60, preferred stats per role)

calibration.verification: one QC fight per tier before CANDIDATE status

economy.binder: srcId of the shared common material (Thread pattern) or NONE

recipes.name: string
recipes.effects_brief: one line per effect with values or dauntless

economy.filler_rewards: per-ending {money, exp, items} or dauntless (slots always reserved)
economy.coprime_check: no drop quantity shares a factor with a recipe requirement

cards.kind: enum: scene | portrait | sprite | icon | quest_icon | poster
cards.chroma: magenta default; NONE for full-bleed scenes/icons

art_pack.processing: component-keyed pipeline (12_TECH 33-35); fresh filenames on corrections

dialog.register: one-line voice note (e.g. 'the House speaks in invitations')

outputs: decision list: every dauntless field with the shipped safe default
delivery_contract.status: everything ships hidden:true CANDIDATE; publishing fields are never filled by the pipeline
